title: Mac full Rust gate reports OS 35 resource exhaustion in 782 tests; investigate process/thread limits
outcome: Determine and correct the measured cause of the Mac full-suite process/resource failures, accounting separately for unrelated assertion failures, while keeping maintained gate bounds and product semantics intact.
acceptance: Preserve the original full-gate logs and exact failure inventory; distinguish the 782 explicit OS 35/resource-unavailable bodies from the two sampled pre-existing fixture classes and 35 other bodies, recording every remaining uncertainty.

Use a bounded reproducer or measured native limits/process/thread evidence to distinguish the actual resource cause from alternatives such as per-user process limits, fixture leaks, concurrency, or host load; an isolated passing test alone is insufficient.

Validate the confirmed correction with relevant focused checks and the maintained Mac full gate under unchanged timeouts/thread policy, or record separately any unrelated remaining failures and their owners. Any global configuration, service or host restart action requires its existing authorization.
